title: When ego insists on the center
issueStatement: Everything loops back to the self: my image, my hurt, my control, my place.
centralInsight: Gurbani does not treat ego as personality. It treats ego as disease, bondage, and distortion.
practicalReflection: The goal is not self-erasure. It is truthful self-placement inside Hukam and Guru's Shabad.
actionPrompt: Notice one sentence in your head today that begins and ends with the self. Lay it beside the shabad honestly.

source.shortMeaning: Ego shapes action and becomes chronic illness.
source.lifeApplication: Seeing ego clearly is part of grace, not failure.

excerpts.explanation: Guru Angad is exact: ego is not a small flaw on top of an otherwise neutral self.

source.lifeApplication: The self becomes quieter when reality is no longer centered around it.

excerpts.explanation: Hukam is not abstract theology here. It is a direct solvent for haumai.

source.shortMeaning: Real gratitude lowers the self before mercy.
source.lifeApplication: Mercy becomes visible when self-importance thins out.

excerpts.explanation: Humility here is not performative modesty. It is truthful dependence.
